verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents a public RESTful JSON API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a Postman collection, official SDKs in many languages and a self-serve sandbox. The API covers core banking operations such as Pix and Ted transfers, boletos, cards and webhooks. Probes confirm machine-readable docs are live (llms.txt and api.md both return HTTP 200); the 404s on standard OpenAPI JSON paths do not contradict the documented YAML download. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, and an OpenAPI spec discoverable at a standard path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
